title: SmartScope Preprocessing Results (.done.json)
description: Written by the compute function after processing. SmartScope reads this to update its database. Must be included in the function's transfer_items so it is transferred back.

batch_id.description: Must match the batch_id from the manifest.

results.description: Per-micrograph results. One entry per successfully processed movie.

movie_path.description: Movie filename (used to match back to SmartScope's HighMagModel). Can be relative or absolute; SmartScope matches on the filename stem.

ctf_max_resolution.description: CTF fit resolution in Angstroms (lower is better). SmartScope displays this as 'CTF resolution'.

ice_thickness.description: Estimated ice thickness in Angstroms. SmartScope converts to nm (divides by 10).

coordinates.description: Picked particle coordinates as [x, y, score] arrays. SmartScope computes mean_pick_score from the scores.

thumbnail.description: Path to micrograph thumbnail PNG, relative to output_dir.

ctf_thumbnail.description: Path to CTF fit thumbnail PNG, relative to output_dir.
